population.span: PATIENT(S): Anovulatory women with the polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) who were resistant to CC.

endpoint.span: Serum P level > or =4 ng/mL was considered to indicate ovulation.

estimate.span: In the metformin and placebo groups, 9 of 12 participants (75%) and 4 of 15 participants (27%) ovulated

treatment_strategy.span: Metformin or placebo was continued and CC treatment was begun at 50 mg daily for 5 days.

follow_up.span: Patients completed the study when they had had six ovulatory cycles, became pregnant, or experienced anovulation while receiving 150 mg of CC.

entry_population_reading.span: PATIENT(S): Anovulatory women with the polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) who were resistant to CC.

analysis_set.served_label: as randomised; background ovulation-induction therapy disclosed per trial
analysis_set.absent_reason: Neither held abstract identifies the analysis population or states that the reported denominators include all randomised participants.

entry_population.extractor_why: The entry population consists of anovulatory women with PCOS resistant to clomiphene alone, within the question's population; both assigned groups subsequently received clomiphene.
